notes: supported means the current Go codegen V1 scope for the language module is backed by explicit goldens.
rejected means the feature is intentionally not generated by Go codegen V1 and must fail with a diagnostic or remain verifier-only.
deferred means the language feature exists in the frontend but has no Go codegen slice yet.

modules.title: Core module structure and top-level diagnostics
modules.summary: Core parsing diagnostics are covered by parser/verifier gates; no dedicated Go codegen slice is needed yet.

modules.title: Import declarations and import diagnostics
modules.summary: Import declaration syntax is frontend-covered; Go project import resolution is tracked in 03_import_resolution.

modules.title: Multi-file import resolution
modules.summary: Project codegen covers two-module Freehold graphs, deterministic Go package paths, and imported routine calls via exposing or qualified module names.

modules.title: Type declarations and type references
modules.summary: Primitive type aliases are emitted as Go aliases.
supported_cases: primitive type aliases go codegen matches

modules.title: Record declarations, literals, and field access
modules.summary: Record declarations and record literals are generated as Go structs and composite literals.

modules.title: Array types, literals, and index access
modules.summary: Array codegen exists in expression/result slices, but the array language module has no dedicated Go goldens yet.

modules.title: String type, literals, comparisons, and built-in functions
modules.summary: String V1 builtins are mapped to Go native/string helpers.

modules.title: Procedures, functions, parameters, calls, and returns
modules.summary: Simple non-generic, non-async routines and local calls are covered.
supported_cases: function returns integer go codegen matches

modules.title: Let, assignment, check, if, while, case, return, and call statements
modules.summary: Core statement forms in Compiler V1 are covered by Go goldens.
supported_cases: field assignment statement go codegen matches

modules.title: Expression precedence, operators, calls, and type errors
modules.summary: Core expression forms and precedence are covered by Go goldens.
supported_cases: integer arithmetic precedence go codegen matches
function call expression go codegen matches
record field expression go codegen matches
array index expression go codegen matches

modules.title: Error declarations and Result return semantics
modules.summary: Result value returns and error returns are represented as Go structs.

modules.title: Cross-cutting type and declaration conflicts
modules.summary: This module is a frontend diagnostics module; invalid conflict cases must not reach Go codegen.
modules.rejected_reason: conflict examples are negative verifier coverage

modules.title: Routine contract blocks
modules.summary: Runtime contract enforcement is not part of Go codegen V1.

modules.title: Comments and whitespace
modules.summary: Comments are parser-neutral and have no dedicated Go codegen behavior beyond successful parsing.

modules.title: Qualified names in routine calls
modules.summary: Current-module qualification and qualified runtime builtin calls are covered.
supported_cases: String qualified built-in call go codegen matches
Std IO qualified procedure call go codegen matches

modules.title: Control-flow edge cases
modules.summary: Core control-flow statements are covered in 09_statements; edge-case path analysis has no Go codegen slice yet.

modules.title: Math standard module and numeric built-ins
modules.summary: Math V1 builtins map to Go math and project codegen skips runtime stubs.
supported_cases: Math trig functions go codegen matches
Math sqrt and pow go codegen matches
Math min and max go codegen matches
Math floor and ceil go codegen matches
Math calls inside expressions go codegen matches

modules.title: String templates with positional and named placeholders
modules.summary: String.template and Std.IO.logf template calls map to fmt.Sprintf/fmt.Println.
supported_cases: String.template formats scalar values go codegen matches
String.template inside Std.IO.logf go codegen matches

modules.title: Big arbitrary-precision standard module
modules.summary: BigInteger/BigFloat runtime mapping is intentionally postponed after the current V1 compiler slices.

modules.title: JSON library builtins
modules.summary: Json.stringify for verifier-limited record values maps to encoding/json with JSON struct tags.

modules.title: Abort handling
modules.summary: Abort propagation is represented as explicit Go error returns for covered V1 cases.

modules.title: Generics
modules.summary: User-defined generic records and routines are explicitly outside Go codegen V1.
modules.rejected_reason: monomorphization and bounds are V2/V3 topics

modules.title: Concurrency V1 Async Await Runtime Channels
modules.summary: Concurrency frontend semantics exist, but runtime execution and Go codegen are parked.

modules.title: gRPC IDL V1 Proto Fields Unary Services
modules.summary: Proto generation is covered by the gRPC path; Go gRPC bindings are a separate later slice.
